semantic_frames.risk: 책을 물어보다 cannot silently mean ask to borrow a book
semantic_frames.strategy: Direct book-existence question in quotation marks, or omit; no indirect quotative grammar.

semantic_frames.risk: Saying a name is not calling a friend
semantic_frames.strategy: Delete calling action if 부르다 not yet introduced.

semantic_frames.risk: Heavy bag receipt is not automatically carry/hold assistance
semantic_frames.strategy: Introduced 들다 for physical lifting; 받다 can remain when actual transfer is narrated.

semantic_frames.risk: Giving a chair may invent unnecessary furniture movement
semantic_frames.strategy: Have guest sit in a chair if that is all the scene needs.
Explicit preference object or concrete smile; otherwise omit.

semantic_frames.risk: Using a knife is not writing; bitter adjective is a separate ID
semantic_frames.strategy: Use Core 사용하다 for a tool; contextual review of adjective bitter.

semantic_frames.risk: Paper room or broad outdoor space is not a seat
semantic_frames.strategy: Describe small paper/large drawing or use 곳 when introduced/contextually natural.

quotation_policy: Direct standalone speech with an explicit speaker is punctuation, not new indirect quotation morphology. Analyze the quoted sentence with the same 32 grammar rules; never license 라고/달라고/nominalization by quotation.
length_policy: 4–7 preferred is soft. If meaningful natural scene remains under 120, redesign with relevant actions or report a gap; never fill with adverbs.
review_defer_policy: Freeze windows. Omitted actual reviews earn no credit. Keep unmet debt for later semantically compatible selection; six actual distinct texts still required at text 300.
